d:
The Warriors defeated the Timberwolves, 119-114 tonight in Minnesota. Stephen Curry finished with a team-high 44 points along with 8 rebounds and 6 assists for the Warriors, while Yaxel Lendeborg tallied 26 points, 9 rebounds and 2 three pointers in the game. Jonathan Kuminga recorded 20 points, 5 assists and 3 rebounds. The Warriors improve their record to 2-3 with the win, while the Timberwolves fall to 3-2 for the season.
